basics.name: Kevin Bishop
basics.label: Digitization & Trade Data Standards · UNECE / UN/CEFACT
basics.summary: Digitization and trade-data standards specialist at UNECE / UN/CEFACT in Geneva. Secretary of the UN/LOCODE Advisory Group and of UN/EDIFACT, focal point for methodology and technology, and Secretary of ISO/TC 154/JWG 9.

work.name: United Nations Economic Commission for Europe (UNECE)
work.summary: Coordinates intergovernmental maintenance and strategic development of UN/LOCODE, the UN Code for Trade and Transport Locations (116,000+ codes).
highlights: Runs the directory release cycle: cut-off schedules, expert review, Data Maintenance Requests under Recommendation No. 16, publication after each UN/CEFACT Forum
Leads modernization with UN OICT and UNICC toward an open-source, version-controlled maintenance environment
Migration of UN/LOCODE, UNTP and the eTIR National Application to the UN open-source platform; due diligence (SBOM, SCA, security, licensing) toward Digital Public Good status
Geolocation tagging, geofencing and AI-assisted validation of requests
Resource mobilization including the contribution-based funding mechanism endorsed at UN/CEFACT Plenary
Capacity building for National Focal Points

work.name: UNECE · UN/CEFACT secretariat, Digital Connectivity Unit
work.summary: Focal point for UN/CEFACT Methodology and Technology; Secretary of UN/EDIFACT.
highlights: Maintenance of UN/EDIFACT, UN/CCL, Reference Data Models, UN/LOCODE and Recommendation code lists
Management of UN/FLUX with FAO, ICCAT and regional fisheries bodies
Support to JSON Schema, JSON-LD web vocabulary, Verifiable Credentials and API specifications
Servicing of UN/CEFACT Plenary, Forum, Bureau and expert meetings
Communications and outreach for the Digital Connectivity Unit and UN/CEFACT; management of the CUE (Confluence) environment
Co-Chair, UN Digital Transformation Group for Europe and Central Asia

work.name: International Organization for Standardization (ISO)
work.summary: Joint ISO/UNECE working group on information exchange in the supply chain aligned to UN/CEFACT semantics.
highlights: ISO/WD 5909 DLT-based electronic bill of lading
ISO/PWI 16356 edible agricultural products on blockchain/DLT

work.name: Haigh Communications Inc.
work.summary: Single point of contact for ICT at a Barbados PR consultancy serving the Government of Barbados and UNICEF, from network infrastructure to first-line support.

work.name: The University of the West Indies
work.summary: Taught Computing I and Entrepreneurship for Computer Sciences to classes of 15 to 40 students, covering Java, C++, JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS.

work.name: UNDP
work.summary: Consultant analyst producing statistical research for UNDP and UN-Women, including a Caribbean multi-dimensional poverty paper and a gender analysis of OECS poverty.

volunteer.organization: Deacon's Farm community, St. Michael, Barbados
volunteer.summary: Plans, develops and runs community programmes and keeps government officials informed of community proposals. Supported UNODC's rapid Urban Safety Governance Assessment in Barbados (December 2020) by mobilizing residents to provide qualitative data.

volunteer.position: Committee Chairperson and grant proposal writer

projects.name: Speaker, NTFC Session 11: climate-smart trade facilitation, Global Supply Chain Forum 2024 (Bridgetown, Barbados)
projects.description: Spoke for UNECE on standardization in supply-chain due diligence, interoperability and standardized data sets.
